definition: to quickly buy a hot drink to take away
description: A smiling young woman in an orange helmet and orange jacket glides past a small wooden coffee hut with a striped awning on a mountain ridge at sunrise, hanging in her paraglider harness under a wide wing. She takes a paper coffee cup from a bearded man leaning out of the hut, where a coffee machine steams, and flies on holding the cup. She passes cheering hikers and a jumping dog on the rocky path and glides away over a sea of pink clouds, with other paragliders drifting in the distance.

de.answer: Sie schnappt sich an der Hütte einen Kaffee.
de.question: Was macht die Gleitschirmfliegerin?

es.answer: Está cogiendo un café en la caseta.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo la parapentista?

fr.answer: Elle attrape au passage un café à la cabane.
